TITLE: Station auto logoff
SOURCE: guides/Platform/Rerendered.html

A station logs off an idle user after the session timeout.

If your station connection is via Workbench, a similar warning displays.

As of Niagara 4.15, the Absolute Logoff option logs users out after an absolute timeout.

Per user in the baja-User component by enabling the Absolute  Logoff Enabled property.

Parent topic: User authentication
